A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same MKDT study with complete main text and Appendices A–G. Text and rendered-page comparisons cover all 27 pages, including figures, tables, and equations, without material reading gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original MKDT experiments in Tables 1–7, trajectory analyses in Figure 1, and additional experimental results in Appendices B and F.

after.justification: v3 retains the original MKDT experiments, trajectory measurements, and additional appendix results. These remain original empirical outcomes despite being unchanged from v2.

M1.justification: Section 4.2 and Algorithm 1 retain identical teacher training, knowledge-distillation trajectories, synthetic-data initialization, optimization, and evaluation procedures.

E1.justification: Both retain CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and TinyImageNet pre-training and the same downstream classification datasets, including Cars in Appendix B. No dataset, task, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparator rows, including random and SAS subsets, KRR-ST, no-pre-training and full-data references, and the DM and MTT-SSL adaptations in Appendix F.

E3.justification: Distilled-set sizes, labeled-data fractions, linear-probe evaluations, Appendix B fine-tuning, model configurations, and optimization settings are unchanged. The reflowed experimental prose introduces no protocol revision.

E4.justification: The trajectory and batch-size analyses in Figure 1, initialization and SSL-algorithm ablations in Tables 2 and 6, architecture-transfer study in Table 5, and Appendix E image examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: The tables retain identical uncertainty reporting, and Appendix A.2 retains its five-trajectory description. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Experimental values and findings in Tables 1–7 and 10–12 and Figures 1–4 are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains MKDT's CIFAR10 result of 53.08±0.13 with 2% distilled data and 5% labels.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives, Theorem 4.1 and its Appendix C proof, and Proposition D.1 and its Appendix D proof are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty claim, explanation of MKDT's contribution, and claimed accuracy gains of up to 13%. No central claim is strengthened or narrowed.

C2.justification: The SSL-gradient-variance explanation, interpretation of larger architectures' data requirements, and Appendix G discussion of amplifying dataset biases are unchanged. No new limitation or applicability qualification appears.

D1.justification: Appendix A's implementation instructions and hyperparameters, Appendix F's adaptation details, and the code-access information are unchanged. The new funding acknowledgment adds no technical reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, the scientific citations, and the reference list are unchanged. The positioning relative to prior dataset distillation, subset selection, and knowledge distillation remains identical.

P1.justification: v3 adds an Acknowledgments paragraph after Section 6 crediting NSF CAREER Award 2146492 and an Amazon PhD fellowship, updates the arXiv version/date stamp, and corrects spacing before a comma. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Small spacing adjustments on pages 9–10 shift Table 5 upward and move the end of the downstream-generalization paragraph onto page 9, accommodating acknowledgments on page 10. Figures, table structures, and captions are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding attribution and makes small formatting adjustments. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, proofs, limitations, and reproducibility documentation—including all appendices—remain unchanged, leaving overall paper quality essentially the same.
